description: This Java class defines a rule engine node for logging messages in the Thingsboard platform. It supports scripting for message transformation and logs the output.

classes.name: TbLogNode
classes.description: A rule node for logging messages with optional scripting transformation in Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, setting up scripting if needed.

methods.name: createScriptEngine
methods.description: Creates a scripting engine based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, performing logging or scripting execution.

methods.name: isStandard
methods.description: Determines if the node configuration uses standard scripting.

methods.name: logStandard
methods.description: Logs message data and metadata in standard mode.

methods.name: toLogMessage
methods.description: Formats message data and metadata into a log string.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroying the scripting engine if initialized.
